flags: Two Dell subsidiaries, Dell International L.L.C. and EMC Corporation, completed a public offering of four series of senior unsecured notes, including $1,250,000,000 of 5.100% Senior Notes due 2029.
Dell raised its full-year revenue outlook by $25 billion to $192 billion in its second-quarter earnings release.
The board declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.63 per common share.

business_model.claim: Dell sells technology solutions that range from client devices and peripherals to servers, networking and storage infrastructure.
quotes: These solutions range from client devices and peripherals to infrastructure solutions across servers, networking, and storage to meet the evolving needs of our customers and drive better business outcomes.

business_model.claim: The company reports two segments, Infrastructure Solutions Group (ISG) and Client Solutions Group (CSG). Divested or no-longer-sold businesses such as VMware Resale sit in Corporate and other.
quotes: We are organized into two business units which are also our reportable segments: Infrastructure Solutions Group and Client Solutions Group.
These offerings are no longer actively sold and Corporate and other is not classified as an operating segment.

business_model.claim: ISG has three product categories. In the latest quarter AI-Optimized Servers revenue was $16,401, Traditional Servers and Networking 10,531 and Storage 4,850, for total ISG net revenue of $31,782 (table in millions).
quotes: •Record AI-Optimized Servers revenue: $16.4 billion, up 100% year over year

business_model.claim: CSG sells branded PCs and peripherals plus third-party software and peripherals. In the latest quarter Commercial revenue was $13,192 and Consumer 1,842, for total CSG net revenue of $15,034 (table in millions).
quotes: Our major product categories within CSG are our commercial offerings and consumer offerings.

business_model.claim: ISG now generates most segment profit. In the latest quarter ISG operating income was $4,781 at 15.0% of ISG revenue and CSG operating income was $1,142 at 7.6% (table in millions). ISG's share of total reportable segment operating income was 81%, against 65% a year earlier.

Revenue is mainly product sales. In the latest quarter Products revenue was $41,112 and Services revenue was 5,859 (table in millions). Services revenue was essentially unchanged from 5,841 a year earlier.

business_model.basis: stated in P1; channel types also listed in P2
business_model.claim: Dell sells through a direct sales force and a global network of channel partners in over 170 countries.
quotes: Our go-to-market operations include an extensive direct sales force, with the ability to build deep customer relationships, and a global network of channel partners.

Dell Technologies operates globally in over 170 countries, supported by a world-class organization across key functional areas, including technology and product development, marketing, sales, services, and financing.

business_model.claim: Customers are concentrated in the Americas, which account for about 65% of ISG revenue and about 60% of CSG revenue. Sales outside the United States were about 45% of consolidated net revenue in the latest full fiscal year.
quotes: Approximately 60% of CSG revenue is generated by sales to customers in the Americas, with the remaining portion derived from sales to customers in EMEA and APJ.
Sales outside the United States accounted for approximately 45% of our consolidated net revenue for Fiscal 2026.

business_model.claim: AI server buyers are concentrated: so far they have mainly been a small number of larger customers and cloud service providers.
quotes: While we expect the buyer base for our AI solutions to continue to expand, to date our AI solutions have been purchased primarily by a small number of larger customers and cloud service providers.

business_model.basis: stated in P6 (executive quote in release)
business_model.claim: AI server demand drives revenue through orders and backlog. In the latest quarter the company booked $60.9 billion in AI server orders and ended with a $95 billion backlog.
quotes: That’s clearest in our AI server business where we booked a record $60.9 billion in orders, recognized a record $16.4 billion in revenue and exited the quarter with a record $95 billion backlog.

business_model.basis: stated in P4; P2 adds that large orders may occur in some periods and not others
business_model.claim: AI server revenue is lumpy because the timing of demand and shipments is non-linear.
quotes: Given the scale of the AI opportunities, the varying stages of customer readiness, and the frequency of component part updates or transitions, there is inherent non-linearity in the timing of demand and subsequent shipments for our AI-optimized servers offerings, which continues to drive variability in our revenue.

business_model.claim: Technology refresh cycles are a second revenue driver: data-center modernization in ISG and the PC refresh cycle in CSG.
quotes: Additionally, within our CSG business, the PC refresh cycle is underway as customers continue to upgrade their devices, which has contributed to significant demand for our commercial offerings.

business_model.claim: Revenue is seasonal: storage sales are typically stronger in the fourth fiscal quarter.
quotes: Within ISG, our storage sales are typically stronger in our fourth fiscal quarter.

business_model.claim: Through Dell Financial Services, the company also earns from financing customer purchases. DFS funded $11.9 billion of originations in the latest full fiscal year and held a $14.3 billion portfolio of financing receivables.
quotes: DFS funded $11.9 billion of originations in Fiscal 2026 and as of January 30, 2026 maintains a $14.3 billion global portfolio of financing receivables with a strong credit quality.

business_model.claim: Financing receivables grew during the latest half year. Short-term financing receivables rose to 12,805 from 8,458 and long-term to 7,625 from 5,822 (table in millions).
Recurring revenue comes from maintenance, operating leases, subscription, as-a-Service and usage-based offerings.
quotes: We define recurring revenue as revenue recognized that is primarily related to hardware and software maintenance as well as operating leases, subscription, as-a-Service, and usage-based offerings.

business_model.claim: Cost of revenue is the dominant cost. In the latest quarter total cost of net revenue was 37,141 against total net revenue of $46,971 (table in millions).
Component costs drive cost of revenue. Input costs rose because of higher component costs, and the company expects component cost inflation to persist for the rest of the fiscal year.
quotes: We experienced an increase in input costs, driven by higher component costs.
We expect the notable inflationary environment for component costs will persist throughout the remainder of Fiscal 2027.

business_model.basis: stated in P4; rates stated in P6
business_model.claim: Mix shift toward AI-optimized servers pressures the gross margin rate. Even so, the quarterly gross margin rate was 20.9%, against 18.3% a year earlier.
quotes: We expect margin growth, while balancing anticipated margin rate pressure resulting from a continuing shift in mix towards our AI-optimized servers offerings.

business_model.claim: The company depends on third-party vendors and contract manufacturers for components and assembly, and vendor pricing and rebates affect its profitability.
quotes: We obtain many products and all of our components from third-party vendors, many of which are located outside of the United States.

Our profitability is affected by our ability to achieve favorable pricing from vendors and contract manufacturers, including through negotiations for vendor rebates, marketing funds, and other vendor funding received in the normal course of business.

material_events.basis: Stated in the 8-K Item 1.01 [P8] and the 8-K Item 8.01 [P9].
material_events.claim: Two Dell subsidiaries, Dell International L.L.C. and EMC Corporation, completed a public offering of four series of senior unsecured notes, including $1,250,000,000 of 5.100% Senior Notes due 2029.
quotes: completed a public offering (the “Offering”) of (i) $1,250,000,000 aggregate principal amount of 5.100% Senior Notes due 2029 (the “2029 Notes”)

The Issuers intend to use the net proceeds from the offering of Notes to repay their outstanding 4.900% First Lien Notes due 2026 and any remaining proceeds for general corporate purposes, which may include the repayment of other debt.

material_events.basis: Stated in the 10-K Item 1 [P1] and the 10-K Item 7 [P3].
material_events.claim: After Broadcom acquired VMware, Dell terminated its Commercial Framework Agreement with VMware and stopped acting as a distributor of VMware standalone products.
quotes: On March 25, 2024, we terminated our Commercial Framework Agreement with VMware, whereby we acted as a distributor of VMware standalone products and services.

risks.basis: Risk mechanism is stated in the 10-K risk factors and the 10-Q MD&A. Its scale is inferred from balance-sheet and cash-flow changes.
risks.claim: AI-driven component buying has sharply expanded working capital: inventories rose to 21,290 from 10,437 and accounts payable to 49,723 from 33,630 (table in millions), and second-quarter operating cash flow fell to $2,225 from $2,543, a (13)% change.
quotes: Larger orders may also require greater commitments of working capital, such as for purchases of key components, which could adversely affect our cash flow and expose us to the risk of holding excess and obsolete inventory due to delays or cancellations.

To meet the growing demand and increasing complexity of our AI-optimized servers offerings, we have increased our purchases of certain components with suppliers, which has resulted in increased inventory levels, higher purchase obligations, and new working capital dynamics.

risks.basis: Concentration is stated in the 10-K risk factors. Backlog and diversification figures are stated in the earnings release.
risks.claim: AI server demand is concentrated in a small number of large customers and cloud service providers, so results depend on a few buyers.
quotes: While we expect the buyer base for our AI solutions to continue to expand, to date our AI solutions have been purchased primarily by a small number of larger customers and cloud service providers.

Sales of AI to large customers may also cause fluctuations in our results of operations, as such large orders may occur in some periods and not others and are generally subject to intense competition and pricing pressure, which can have an impact on our gross margins and results of operations.

risks.basis: Mechanism is stated in the 10-K risk factors. The growth in exposure is inferred from balance-sheet and cash-flow lines.
risks.claim: Customer credit exposure is rising: short-term financing receivables grew to 12,805 from 8,458, their allowance rose to $186 from $121, and the financing receivables cash outflow was (6,404) against (569) a year earlier (tables in millions).
quotes: These transactions may also involve larger amounts of credit or longer payment terms than have been typical for our business, increasing our risks in the event customers do not pay or make timely payment, particularly where our payment terms with major suppliers of underlying components differ from the payment terms of our customers.

risks.basis: Stated in the 10-Q MD&A. Margin rates are stated in the earnings release.
risks.claim: Component cost inflation, especially in memory, may pressure margins, and management expects it to continue for the rest of the fiscal year.
quotes: We experienced an increase in input costs, driven by higher component costs.
We expect the notable inflationary environment for component costs will persist throughout the remainder of Fiscal 2027.

risks.basis: Inferred. Non-linearity is stated in the 10-Q MD&A and guidance figures in the earnings release; no item states that guidance is at risk.
risks.claim: Full-year revenue guidance was raised to $192.0 billion, up 69%, and lumpy AI shipment timing could make that target harder to meet.
quotes: Given the scale of the AI opportunities, the varying stages of customer readiness, and the frequency of component part updates or transitions, there is inherent non-linearity in the timing of demand and subsequent shipments for our AI-optimized servers offerings, which continues to drive variability in our revenue.

risks.basis: Inferred from balance-sheet, cash-flow and 8-K figures. Use of proceeds is stated in the 8-K.
risks.claim: Shareholders' equity remains in deficit at (1,427), and long-term debt rose to 25,985 from 23,513 while buybacks of (5,424) were made in six months (tables in millions).
quotes: Dell Technologies returned a record $4.3 billion to shareholders in the second quarter through share repurchases and dividends.

risks.basis: Stated in the 10-K MD&A and risk factors. The 10-Q reports memory supply constraints.
risks.claim: Supply of next-generation AI components and single-source parts may be constrained, which could delay shipments.
quotes: While we have seen lead times shorten, we anticipate the next generation of these components, for which demand remains high, will be subject to supply constraints.
A delay in the supply of a critical single- or limited-source product or component may prevent the timely shipment of the related product in desired quantities or configurations.

risks.basis: Stated in the 10-K risk factors and MD&A.
risks.claim: Tariffs and trade restrictions could raise costs and limit sales, given that sales outside the United States were about 45% of revenue.
quotes: Trade policies and disputes could result in increased tariffs and other trade restrictions and protectionist measures, which could increase our manufacturing costs, increase prices of and reduce demand for our products, limit our ability to sell to certain customers, hamper our procurement of components or raw materials, or impede or slow the movement of our goods across borders.

risks.basis: Segment shares are stated in the earnings release. Competitive pressure is stated in the 10-K risk factors.
risks.claim: Profit is increasingly concentrated in ISG, which produced 81% of reportable segment operating income in the second quarter against 65% a year earlier.
quotes: ISG offers a portfolio of storage, server, and networking solutions, including AI-optimized technologies, and faces intense competition from existing on-premises competitors and increasing competitive pressures from Infrastructure-as-a-Service providers.

risks.claim: The chief legal officer will retire effective February 1, 2027, creating a senior management transition.
quotes: Mr. Rothberg will remain employed by the Company to provide transitional assistance through April 30, 2027.

risks.claim: The company reports past cyber-attacks that used compromised credentials and expects continued targeting.
quotes: We have experienced cyber-attacks that leveraged compromised credentials of our partners, vendors, employees, and customers to gain unauthorized access to Dell Technologies, partner, and vendor systems and confidential information, including information about our customers, employees, and partners.
